<b>Mothleaf Lagnia</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are floating bugs that disguise themselves as plants to avoid danger.<ref>Mothleaf Lagnia [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"A rare, calmer bug of Bilewater, survives its hazardous surroundings by hiding as a plant."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mothleaf Lagnia are not hostile and float aimlessly but unpredictably up and down. 
Some may be obstructed by plants that have a similar colour to them, but they rise up as soon as [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches.

Despite their non-aggression, they deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Air... so warm...
* Water... so nourishing...
* Land... so fertile...
* Life... light... threads...
}}

== Location ==
Mothleaf Lagnia can be found in the upper area of [[Bilewater]].

==Trivia==
* The plant that Mothleaf Lagnia mimic appears to be the white grass commonly found throughout [[Bilewater]]. When they die and hit the ground, their bodies shatter into the exact same particles as the plant does when broken.
** Their [[Needolin]] dialogue, praising Bilewater's conditions, might also be a form of mimicry, as this same plant can be found in other polluted areas such as the [[Putrified Ducts]] and [[Sinner's Road]], having seemingly adapted to those environments.
* Mothleaf Lagnia do not drop organs for the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> or <i>[[Runtfeast]]</i> [[wishes]].
